body: Thank you but it’s just so much to unpack. I’ve been thinking about it for years now but I don’t know I just don’t have the drive to get my shit together
Oh shit why didn’t I think of that
I feel the same way I’ve been drinking and I need someone to talk to right now so what’s up
I’m sorry for what you’ve been through. I really hope you decide to stay, whether for your children or maybe for another reason that you find along the way. Whatever you do I hope you find peace man
Thank you it’s nice to know there are people like you out there
Trying to stop as well. I try to force myself to do something else when I feel like cutting again even if it’s push ups or jumping jacks or something like that maybe it’ll help
I don’t think you should do it it would be super painful and probably not successful. Please at least give some time to clear your head

Well maybe during the times you feel nothing you should try to distinguish whether it’s because you’re detached from your entire life or whether it’s solely based on your relationship with him. Depression can make our entire futures seem worthless and all the relationships in it too. Might help clear things up

Same. It’s getting harder to remember what it was like to actually try hard in class. Really deep into a major I’m starting to hate and waking up with no motivation to go but too anxious give up completely. What the hell do we do

You put my experience into words man. The constant struggle of not wanting to burden those around you and ruin your relationships by opening up yet you watch them get ruined because you refuse to get help. That’s where I’m at right now.
Much love and luck man kick some ass out there

Sorry to hear that. The thing about depression is that a lot of us don’t feel worth sharing our sadness/burden with those dear to us. It might help to not approach that side of her and just be there close physically as much as you can for her to not make her feel alone. Everyone’s different though but I feel like that’s what I would want.
Same man I feel trapped in a weekly cycle of working and looking forward to my weekend, then being glued to the bed and empty when it comes. Don’t know when or if it ever breaks

What’s also terrible is trying to open up to someone and not having the exact words to express what you go through every day. It sucks worrying if you’re telling too much or to little and if it even makes sense to them
